text:
j.smith (WellHealth): hey team — during our quarterly audit export we noticed a gap in the audit logs for PHI-access events between 2025-11-08 02:00 and 2025-11-08 03:30 UTC. this impacts our BAA report. can you confirm whether logs were dropped or filtered?

alice.chen: thanks for flagging. can you paste the export job id and any error you saw? also which KMS key is the workspace using for encryption? :eyes:

j.smith (WellHealth): job id: export-wellhealth-20251108-01. UI shows export completed but missing ~3k events. in the export svc logs I see repeated 403s to the key API during rotation window. snippet from the export job log:

```
2025-11-08T02:12:04Z ERROR export-worker failed to decrypt chunk metadata: AccessDeniedException (403) keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef12-3456
2025-11-08T02:12:05Z WARN retrying chunk fetch (attempt 3)
2025-11-08T02:12:10Z ERROR export-worker final failure for chunk=chunk-8745
```

j.smith (WellHealth): they also attached a copy of their internal audit CSV that shows the missing sequence ids if you want it.

raj.patel: looking. is this the same key that had a scheduled rotation at 02:10 UTC?

j.smith (WellHealth): yes, rotation scheduled automatically by our KMS policy. rotation window was 02:08-02:15.

alice.chen: initial thought: if the export worker tried to access old-encrypted artifacts during the key rotation and got transient 403s, some chunks might have been skipped and marked as failed. we should examine the export-worker's retry/skip policy and whether failed chunks were silently omitted from final CSV. kevin, can you pull the export-worker logs from the host? also check whether the worker honored eventual re-encrypt after rotation.

kevin_infra: grabbing logs now. quick note: export-worker uses streaming decrypt with a 5s timeout per chunk. during heavy rotation traffic we saw a spike in KMS lat and some 429/403s. attaching tail here:

```
[host-12] 2025-11-08T02:09:58Z INFO starting rotateKey for key/abcd-ef12-3456
[host-12] 2025-11-08T02:10:03Z WARN kms proxy throttling, lat=520ms status=429
[host-12] 2025-11-08T02:12:05Z ERROR decrypt failed AccessDeniedException
[host-12] 2025-11-08T02:12:10Z INFO chunk marked SKIPPED chunk-8745
[host-12] 2025-11-08T02:12:11Z INFO export complete with 5 chunks SKIPPED
```

alice.chen: ok that confirms skipped-chunks behavior — we set SKIPPED when decrypt fails after retries. that is a bug for compliance exports; skipped items should trigger job failure, not silent omission. escalating to security/compliance and eng-runtime. nina_legal, fyi for BAA impact.

nina_legal: thanks Alice. need a formal timeline and scope ASAP. can we quickly determine whether the skipped chunks contained PHI? customer needs attestation whether any PHI was not included in their delivered export.

raj.patel: we can reconstruct chunk index -> record id map. starting a reconstruct job to re-decrypt archived chunks using the post-rotation key and fallback to original ciphertext keys if available. ETA ~ 2h. I will also temporarily change export-worker retry policy to fail-on-skip for subsequent compliance exports.

j.smith (WellHealth): appreciate that. customer expects root cause and mitigation steps in writing. they also asked whether this is related to our HSM (we use customer-managed HSM in the Private deployment).

kevin_infra: to clarify — this customer is on Private with bring-your-own KMS backed by HSM. rotation was initiated by their KMS schedule. our proxy logged higher lat / 429s while their key rotated. nothing shows HSM compromise; just transient access denied while rotation locked the key.

alice.chen: proposed immediate actions: 1) run reconstruct job and produce verified export CSV, 2) issue incident memo for BAA timeline + affected record count, 3) change export-worker to treat SKIPPED -> FAILURE for BAA-tagged exports, 4) add increased retries + exponential backoff for KMS ops. Raj/kevin pick up items 1/4, I'll draft memo with Nina.

raj.patel: started reconstruct job. command I used: `./reconstruct_export --job export-wellhealth-20251108-01 --fallback-keys true --output s3://wellhealth-audit-recons/` showing progress: 12% done, decrypt retries in progress.

support-bot: incident created: INC-2025-1179 (severity:high, affected_customer: WellHealth). assigned to eng-runtime, infra, and legal.

nina_legal: once we have the reconstructed CSV, Legal will need: list of timestamps affected, number of patient identifiers, whether data was exfiltrated (we're not seeing evidence), and confirmation that this was a transient access failure not a permissions revocation.

j.smith (WellHealth): their CISO asked specifically for whether KMS key rotation can be scheduled outside business hours and whether we can add a blocking safeguard for exports during rotation windows. can we support that?

kevin_infra: short term: we can add an export lock during detected rotation window (if KMS reports KeyState=PendingImport/Updating). longer-term: add a pre-check in the export workflow that queries KMS for key state and either delay or fail with clear error. I'll submit a PR for the pre-check and a config flag for customers on Private deployments.

alice.chen: labeling follow-ups: (A) reconstruct + deliver verified export (RAJ/KEVIN) — target +4h, (B) memo + customer comms (ALICE/NINA) — target +3h, (C) runtime change to fail-on-skip for BAA exports (RAJ) — target +2d, (D) KMS pre-check + export lock (KEVIN) — target +5d.

j.smith (WellHealth): thanks. please cc our compliance contact when you send the memo: compliance@wellhealth.org. also please include how many exports might have been affected historically (if we can).

raj.patel: noted — running a historical scan to find other exports overlapping known rotation events. initial search shows 1 other export in the past 6 months overlapped a rotation; adding to scope.

alice.chen: good catch. we'll include that in the incident memo and offer to re-run any affected exports.

nina_legal: tagging for escalation to SOC: @kevin_infra please ensure logs retained for 7 years per BAA and that we export signed attestations for the customer.

kevin_infra: logs retention already set to 7y for HIPAA customers, will attach signed S3 object manifest and KMS audit trail to the memo.

j.smith (WellHealth): great — customer wants a short summary for execs and a technical appendix. we'll look for your memo and the reconstructed file.

alice.chen: will post the memo here when ready and update the incident ticket. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

support-bot: INC-2025-1179 updated: state=investigating, severity=high, notes="reconstruct job running"
